archetypes.name: bash-driver
archetypes.rationale: The diff extracts orchestration state into a new Bash phase driver with subtle status, rc, and fallback behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new run-step3-review.sh driver as an executable state machine. Check argv handling, plugin-root resolution, inner loop invocation, result parsing, LOOP_STATUS normalization, and whether SKILL.md still observes every status it needs when the driver fails or cannot write its result env. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-state
archetypes.rationale: Review-round counters, HARD cursor advancement, and rollback semantics are high-risk workflow state changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace review-round-count.txt, .step3-review-cap.env, .step3-review-result.env, and plan-review-round-cursor.txt across cap-reached, normal completion, panel-failed, tally-error, degraded-empty-collector, and HARD round advancement paths. Compare the new driver behavior against the plan and the removed inline SKILL.md logic. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: quiet-io
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces lib-quiet usage and alters collector stderr handling, which can break machine-readable streams.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review quiet-by-default stream handling in lib-phase-driver.sh, run-step3-review.sh, SKILL.md command substitution, and the plan-review-loop.sh collector stderr change. Look for lost KVs, diagnostics sent to the wrong fd, command substitution surprises, or behavior drift when LARCH_QUIET_PID and LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE are set. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-parity
archetypes.rationale: Several harnesses were retargeted from inline SKILL.md blocks to the new driver and may no longer exercise equivalent contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate whether the new and modified harnesses actually cover the behavior that moved out of SKILL.md. Pay attention to stubs, fixture plugin roots, assertions that became weaker, duplicated invocations that mutate counters, and Makefile shard registration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
